name: maktab
description: tahrir keeps docs true to code (doc-budget gate, ADRs); momayezi runs a review ↔ fix loop, locally or against the remote momayez reviewer; tarahi drafts shaping docs and publishes them to Linear.

tahrir_proactivity.title: tahrir · Proactivity
tahrir_proactivity.description: eager: offers a doc pass after code changes. suggest: a one-line offer, then waits. on-request: only when asked or /maktab:tahrir is run. off: on-request, and the prompt-time doc-gate reminder is muted too. A repo's own doc rules still win.

tahrir_steward_consent.title: tahrir · Steward pass edits
tahrir_steward_consent.description: apply: edit docs, then report. propose: show the planned edits and wait for a yes. ADRs are always drafted for approval first.

tahrir_setup_profile.title: tahrir · Setup profile
tahrir_setup_profile.description: Profile /maktab:tahrir setup proposes for a new repo's .docs.toml; the repo's file decides after that.

momayezi_reviewer_model.title: momayezi · Reviewer model floor
momayezi_reviewer_model.description: Weakest model reviewers may run on; reviewers get the stronger of this and the editor's own model. floor>escalate (e.g. sonnet>opus): under smart sizing, a Large/Max or risky change moves up to the second. /maktab:momayezi --model overrides per run.

momayezi_reviewer_effort.title: momayezi · Reviewer effort
momayezi_reviewer_effort.description: Effort for reviewer and verifier spawns; empty keeps the reviewer agent's own (high). base>escalated (e.g. medium>xhigh) escalates like the model setting.

momayezi_queue_timeout.title: momayezi · Remote queue timeout
momayezi_queue_timeout.description: Seconds a remote review may sit queued, with no runner on it, before the waiter reports 'no runner picked it up'. Empty: the whole --remote-timeout.

momayezi_limit_wait_max.title: momayezi · Wait out a usage limit
momayezi_limit_wait_max.description: Most seconds a remote loop sleeps for the reviewer's usage limit to reset before requesting again. 0 or empty: stop at once, saying when it resets.

momayezi_size_ignore.title: momayezi · Size-ignored globs
momayezi_size_ignore.description: Comma-separated globs smart sizing leaves out of its line and file counts, beside linguist-generated paths and lock files. Lenses still see them.

momayezi_max_rounds.title: momayezi · Max rounds
momayezi_max_rounds.description: Round cap per loop; the capped round reviews at full scope. /maktab:momayezi --max-rounds overrides per run.

momayezi_max_reviewers.title: momayezi · Max reviewers
momayezi_max_reviewers.description: Most lenses (one reviewer each) auto-picked per round, and most reviewers running at once; an explicit --lenses list is never trimmed and runs in waves of this size. /maktab:momayezi --max-reviewers overrides per run.

momayezi_smart.title: momayezi · Smart sizing
momayezi_smart.description: Size reviewers, rounds and (for trivial mechanical changes) model from the change's size and risk. /maktab:momayezi --smart or --no-smart overrides per run.

momayezi_reviewer_backend.title: momayezi · Remote reviewer backend
momayezi_reviewer_backend.description: What starts a --reviewer remote round. repo: the repo's .momayez.toml backend, else gh-label. gh-label: the PR's review label. gh-dispatch: a momayez.yaml dispatch, which fires no pull_request workflow. k8s-job: a Job from the repo's template. $MOMAYEZI_REVIEWER_BACKEND overrides.

momayezi_pr_comments.title: momayezi · PR comments
momayezi_pr_comments.description: all: the editor-ledger comment, finding replies and the reviewer's post. none: ledgers go straight between the loop and the reviewer, and nothing is written to the PR (not with gh-label). auto: all for gh-label and gh-dispatch, none for k8s-job.
